clean_description: Writers & Lovers follows Casey Peabody, a young woman grappling with the recent death of her mother and the fallout from a failed love affair. As she navigates life in Massachusetts in 1997, working as a waitress and struggling to complete her novel, Casey finds herself torn between two very different romantic interests. The novel explores her journey of artistic ambition, vulnerability, and the challenges of balancing personal desires with the demands of life.
